claims.promise: The creator sets a brand kit (logo, colors, two fonts) once and picks a platform family before editing, so every new cover starts on-brand instead of rebuilding styles from scratch in each network app.

evidence.finding: Canva (500M+, IAP) owns brand-kit + multi-format expectation; Unfold/Graphionica/StoryArt each show 10M+ on story shelves while YouTube thumbnail makers separately hold 5M–10M+ — creators already hop networks, and no thin mid-tier ships one offline brand kit across those sizes.

comparison.limitation: YouTube-centric; no durable cross-network brand kit for IG/TikTok/WA sizes.

proof.assertion: BrandScreen launches ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia for the logo; BrandKitStore persists logo/colors/fonts; DestinationsScreen lists DestinationCatalog (yt_thumb, yt_shorts, ig_post, ig_story, tiktok_cover, wa_status) before the editor opens.

claims.promise: A real layered canvas (photo, text with stroke, stickers, shapes, safe-zone overlay per platform) edits the cover on-device without an AI key, with projects that reopen after save.

evidence.finding: Thumbnail Maker for YouTubers (2.1★, 100K+) critical review: saved projects inaccessible and users forced to screenshot; Channel art app (10M+, 4.2★) review: exports become blurry/distorted — the mid-tier fails durability and output quality.

comparison.limitation: Projects inaccessible after save; users screenshot to keep work.

proof.assertion: ProjectCodecTest.roundTripsPhotoTextAndStickerLayers round-trips photo/text/sticker layers; EditorScreen edits Layer sealed types; FileProjectStore saves under filesDir/projects so drafts reopen after kill.

claims.promise: One finished design exports a sharp native-resolution pack for YouTube (16:9 + Shorts), Instagram (post + story/reel), TikTok cover and WhatsApp status, shareable via the system sheet or saved through SAF — not a single blurry screenshot.

evidence.finding: Among 8 critical reviews in the YouTube thumbnail pocket sample, paywall was 38% (3/8) and broken 25% (2/8); Channel art verbatim: high-quality uploads become "blurry" and "unprofessional" after edit; Banner Studio locks save behind subscription.

comparison.limitation: Single-network output and reported soft/blurry exports; save often watermarked or gated.

proof.assertion: ExportRenderer draws Bitmap.createBitmap at catalog pixels; EditorScreen shares via FileProvider + Intent.ACTION_SEND / ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE and saves via MediaStore; DestinationCatalogTest asserts exact sizes; Sizes pack multi-select exports multiple PNGs.

claims.promise: Save and multi-export unlock once forever — no subscription, and free drafts are not silently stripped of Pro features later.

evidence.finding: Story pocket: paywall 46% of 13 critical reviews; verbatim Pro-only templates after years of use and paid Pro not activating; thumbnail Banner Studio: subscription required to save and watermark returns.

proof.assertion: ProductId coverkit_unlock is the only SKU via BillingPurchaseGate; FileProjectStore.save works while locked; ExportRenderer watermark applies when unlocked=false; no subscription product is declared.
